scope: Formal ionic composition with explicitly scoped evidence. Selecting a cell never authorizes synthesis.

conditions.label: Formal composition only

conditions.label: Aqueous textbook example
conditions.description: Evidence concerns the specific aqueous example in the cited section. Concentration-dependent equilibrium and quantitative thresholds are not supplied or automatically enforced by this record.

conditions.label: Solid composition example
conditions.description: Evidence supports the named ionic solid and its composition; it supplies no preparation route or reaction permission.

evidence.title: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, 2.6 Ionic and Molecular Compounds

evidence.title: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, 4.2 Classifying Chemical Reactions
evidence.scope: Supports the specifically annotated barium sulfate precipitation, acid/base water formation and aqueous acetic acid examples. No general synthesis or quantitative equilibrium claim.
